title: Yolanda H NDE 6059
content: That morning my mom woke me up and told me to get ready to go to school and I told her I didn't wanted to go. She said, 'Okay don't go', but a couple minutes later she went back in the room and said, 'No, you're going to school, come on, get up and get ready.' I got up and got ready and went out the door with her, but forgot my backpack. My mom said to go back inside and get it and that she was going to be waiting for me in the car. I went in, got my backpack, and went outside. I had to cross the street to get to the car. My mom screamed at me, 'Cross now! Cross now!' I hesitated a little because a car was coming, but I crossed and that's when the car hit me. The next thing I remember is getting up from the floor but my body was still lying down. I saw white clouds all over. I looked up to sky and there were more clouds. I didn't see God but I had faith he was there and I knew I was dead. I saw a shadow of a thin tall man looking down at me from the cloud, this man was walking on the cloud. I started to beg God to let me live. I said, 'God please let me live; if I die my mom and my brothers are going to cry a lot for me. God please let me live. I don't want to die right now; I'm too young. I want to grow up get married and have children. After that, you can take me but not now.' I said this many times over and over. I looked up to the sky again and I saw a red, flying humanoid. It was like a human being but with large long wings and red all over. This humanoid was hovering at the edge of the cloud in the sky. I kept begging God to let me live and I saw my great grandma who had died more than twenty years from that day. My grandma screamed, 'My God!' and I breathed. I was back in my body. I opened my eyes and I saw two nurses coming down from the clouds toward me; one nurse went to my right side and the other nurse to my left side. All I could see were their silhouettes. There were two paramedics there, one on each side, but all I could see were their silhouettes. Their silhouettes were formed of many black dots and the outer of the silhouettes were many white dots. I lifted up my hand to touch the face of the nurse that was on my right side but my hand went through her face. I lifted my hand again to touch her face but the paramedic on my right side got my hand and placed it down. I have seen ghosts but I ignore them. I'm afraid that if they know I can see them they're going to bug me, use me or scare me. I have heard voices in the wind but pretend I can't hear. I have always had faith in God; it's something my mom taught me and I will always have faith in him.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw “a shadow of a thin tall man looking down at me from the cloud… walking on the cloud” and later “a red, flying humanoid… with large long wings and red all over… hovering at the edge of the cloud.”

environment.environment_other_detail: “White clouds all over… more clouds… a red, flying humanoid… hovering at the edge of the cloud in the sky.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit by a car while crossing the street to her mother’s car.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered cloud realm with figures (thin tall man shadow; red winged humanoid) and later saw silhouettes of nurses/paramedics while returning.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with cloud environment and beings occurred without tunnel/light/life review/boundary; return followed after great-grandmother exclaimed “My God!” and she breathed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described “two nurses coming down from the clouds” and silhouettes of nurses/paramedics made of black dots with white-dot outlines; attempted to touch a nurse and her hand went through the face.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next thing I remember is getting up from the floor but my body was still lying down.” “I saw white clouds all over.” “I knew I was dead.” “God please let me live…” “My grandma screamed, ‘My God!’ and I breathed.”
